issue.title: File sizes and transfer speeds display JavaScript text instead of readable units

cases.note: Base commit is the head of the recorded run in docs/evidence/github-run-35464615209.json. The commit's own patchproof.json pins node-package, which cannot edit lib/utils/format.ts (TypeScript), so no repair can be evaluated under it; the harness replaces that file with patchproof_config before each trial. Trials recorded before this override (rc.20 t1-t3, rc.21 smoke) used the old pin and are not comparable.
